key: Hi there!
en: Hi there!
ja: こんにちは!

key: What do you think about Qwilfish? Aren't they cute?!
en: What do you think about Qwilfish? Aren't they cute?!
ja: ハリーセンってどう思う? かわいくない?!

key: Don't you just want to cuddle one?!
en: Don't you just want to cuddle one?!
ja: 抱きしめたくならない?!

key: What do you mean, that'd hurt?
en: What do you mean, that'd hurt?
ja: え、痛いって、どういうこと?

key: Think how sad it must be to be a Qwilfish and no one ever wants to cuddle you...
en: Think how sad it must be to be a Qwilfish and no one ever wants to cuddle you...
ja: 誰にも抱きしめてもらえないハリーセンの気持ちを考えてみてよ、悲しいと思わない?……

key: Anyway, just-- look, do you have one?
en: Anyway, just-- look, do you have one?
ja: とにかく、その――ねえ、持ってる?

key: I would totally be willing to trade you one of my Munchlax for a Qwilfish!
en: I would totally be willing to trade you one of my Munchlax for a Qwilfish!
ja: ハリーセンとなら、うちのゴンベを喜んで交換するよ!

key: No, it's okay! I wouldn't want to part with one either.
en: No, it's okay! I wouldn't want to part with one either.
ja: ううん、いいの! わたしだって手放したくないもの。

key: Really?! Oh my God, you're the best!
en: Really?! Oh my God, you're the best!
ja: 本当に?! やだ、あなた最高!

key: \PN traded Qwilfish for Munchlax!
en: \PN traded Qwilfish for Munchlax!
ja: \PNはハリーセンとゴンベを交換した!

key: To be honest, this is gonna save me a fortune on PokéSnax too.
en: To be honest, this is gonna save me a fortune on PokéSnax too.
ja: 正直、これでポケスナック代もかなり浮くと思う。

key: Double score!
en: Double score!
ja: 一石二鳥だね!

key: This thing is the best! Thank you so much!
en: This thing is the best! Thank you so much!
ja: この子、最高だよ! 本当にありがとう!

key: Aaagh, I was just about to beat Charlotte...
en: Aaagh, I was just about to beat Charlotte...
ja: うわああ、あと少しでシャルロットに勝てるところだったのに……

key: And then she pulls out her damn Ultra Potion and it's all zeroes from there!
en: And then she pulls out her damn Ultra Potion and it's all zeroes from there!
ja: そしたらあいつ、クソみたいなすごいきずぐすりを出してきて、そこから全部台無しだよ!

key: Real Trainers shouldn't have to use items, don't you agree?!
en: Real Trainers shouldn't have to use items, don't you agree?!
ja: 本物のトレーナーなら道具なんて使うべきじゃないよな、そう思わないか?!

key: Yeah, you get it!
en: Yeah, you get it!
ja: だよな、分かってくれるか!

key: People like us are the REAL warriors!
en: People like us are the REAL warriors!
ja: 俺たちみたいなやつこそが、本物の戦士なんだよ!

key: Hey, if you wanna be a real warrior, check this out--
en: Hey, if you wanna be a real warrior, check this out--
ja: なあ、本物の戦士になりたいなら、これ聞いてくれ――

key: Next time someone asks you for a password, tell them "noitems"!
en: Next time someone asks you for a password, tell them "noitems"!
ja: 今度誰かに合言葉を聞かれたら、「noitems」って言うんだ!

key: This will hold both you and your opponents to a code of honor!
en: This will hold both you and your opponents to a code of honor!
ja: それで、お前も相手も名誉のおきてに縛られるってわけさ!

key: No items in battle--
en: No items in battle--
ja: バトル中は道具なし――

key: Only a real warrior can win without them!
en: Only a real warrior can win without them!
ja: 道具なしで勝てるのは、本物の戦士だけだ!

key: Do you have what it takes, comrade!?
en: Do you have what it takes, comrade!?
ja: お前にその覚悟はあるか、相棒!?

key: Then what good are you!?
en: Then what good are you!?
ja: じゃあ、お前は何の役に立つんだよ!?

key: Hello, stranger.
en: Hello, stranger.
ja: やあ、見知らぬ者よ。

key: You are experiencing me as a vivid hallucination because your save file was started on an older version of the game than this one.
en: You are experiencing me as a vivid hallucination because your save file was started on an older version of the game than this one.
ja: お前が今わしを鮮明な幻覚として体験しているのは、お前のセーブデータがこのバージョンより古いバージョンで始められたからだ。

key: Don't worry about it.
en: Don't worry about it.
ja: 気にするな。

key: What you need to know is that at some point since you first arrived here, someone added these "passwords" to the game.
en: What you need to know is that at some point since you first arrived here, someone added these "passwords" to the game.
ja: 知っておくべきなのは、お前が最初にここに来て以降のどこかで、誰かがこのゲームに「合言葉」というものを追加したということだ。

key: They are mostly for new arrivals, but a benevolent entity has seen fit to bestow upon you one opportunity to apply a select few passwords to your current adventure should you be so inclined.
en: They are mostly for new arrivals, but a benevolent entity has seen fit to bestow upon you one opportunity to apply a select few passwords to your current adventure should you be so inclined.
ja: これらは主に新規の者向けだが、慈悲深い存在が、お前が望むなら現在の冒険にもいくつかの合言葉を適用する機会を一度だけ授けることにした。

key: Here are some options to consider:
en: Here are some options to consider:
ja: 考慮すべき選択肢はこうだ:

key: This will make it so that, provided you have the TMX and relevant badge, you may use any Field Move without having to teach it to your Pokémon.
en: This will make it so that, provided you have the TMX and relevant badge, you may use any Field Move without having to teach it to your Pokémon.
ja: これを選べば、わざマシンXと該当のバッジさえ持っていれば、ポケモンに覚えさせなくてもフィールドわざを使えるようになる。

key: Shall I?
en: Shall I?
ja: 適用するか?

key: Got it.
en: Got it.
ja: 承知した。

key: In the future, you can play this mode by using the password "easyhms"
en: In the future, you can play this mode by using the password "easyhms"
ja: 今後は、合言葉「easyhms」を使えば、このモードでプレイできる。

key: I'll make sure it's not a factor.
en: I'll make sure it's not a factor.
ja: それが要因にならないようにしておこう。

key: This will eliminate damage variance from the battle system, producing more stable battles based on the damage's average point.
en: This will eliminate damage variance from the battle system, producing more stable battles based on the damage's average point.
ja: これを選べば、バトルシステムからダメージのばらつきをなくし、平均ダメージ値に基づいたより安定したバトルになる。

key: In the future, you can play this way by using the password "nodamageroll"
en: In the future, you can play this way by using the password "nodamageroll"
ja: 今後は、合言葉「nodamageroll」を使えば、この方式でプレイできる。

key: Creative, right?
en: Creative, right?
ja: 独創的な名前だろう?

key: This will set the IVs to max and set EVs of all opposing Trainers in the game to 252 in every stat for a harder challenge.
en: This will set the IVs to max and set EVs of all opposing Trainers in the game to 252 in every stat for a harder challenge.
ja: これを選べば、ゲーム内の敵トレーナー全員の個体値を最大に、努力値を全ステータス252に設定し、より難しい挑戦になる。

key: In the future, you can play this mode by using the password "fullevs"
en: In the future, you can play this mode by using the password "fullevs"
ja: 今後は、合言葉「fullevs」を使えば、このモードでプレイできる。

key: This will set the IVs and EVs of all opposing Trainers to 0, for an easier experience.
en: This will set the IVs and EVs of all opposing Trainers to 0, for an easier experience.
ja: これを選べば、敵トレーナー全員の個体値と努力値をすべて0に設定し、より簡単な体験になる。

key: In the future, you can apply this with the password "litemode"
en: In the future, you can apply this with the password "litemode"
ja: 今後は、合言葉「litemode」でこれを適用できる。

key: Satisfied?
en: Satisfied?
ja: 満足したか?

key: I hope so.
en: I hope so.
ja: そうであることを願う。

key: Because this NPC will now self-destruct.
en: Because this NPC will now self-destruct.
ja: なぜなら、このNPCはこれより自己消滅するからだ。

key: As you wish.
en: As you wish.
ja: お望みのままに。

key: I was never here.
en: I was never here.
ja: わしはここにはいなかった。

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ

key: Free TMX Usage
en: Free TMX Usage
ja: わざマシンX無制限使用

key: No Damage Rolls
en: No Damage Rolls
ja: ダメージ乱数なし

key: Full EVs
en: Full EVs
ja: 努力値満タン

key: Empty E/IVs
en: Empty E/IVs
ja: 個体値・努力値ゼロ
